component 0: [["what is photosynthesis?", "Hi :), How can i help you? \n\nPhotosynthesis is the process by which green plants, algae and chlorophyll containing bacteria utilize sunlight to synthesize their own food from simple inorganic molecules. It results in the production of carbohydrates, oxygen, and other organic compounds. This process is essential for life on earth as it provides energy and organic matter for nearly all living organisms."]]

[["what is glucose?", "Hi :), How can I help you?\n\nGlucose (C6H12O6) is a simple sugar and a primary source of energy for cells. It's an important carbohydrate that serves as fuel for the body and is used by plants during photosynthesis to produce energy.
